items.title: 葡萄牙医院网络与安全基础设施升级采购于10月23日截止投标
items.title_en: Portugal hospital network and cybersecurity infrastructure tender closes on 23 October
items.summary: 葡萄牙Serviço de Utilização Comum dos Hospitais（SUCH）就网络、网络安全、WAN/LAN/Wi-Fi、集中管理、监控及语音平台等现代化设施与相关服务开展采购，预计上限约150万欧元。10月23日是投标截止节点，并非项目首次公告日。
items.summary_en: Portugal's Serviço de Utilização Comum dos Hospitais (SUCH) is procuring network, cybersecurity, WAN/LAN/Wi-Fi, centralised monitoring and voice infrastructure and associated services with an estimated maximum value of EUR1.5 million. The submission deadline is 23 October; this is not a newly announced project.
items.why_it_matters: 采购有明确招标主体、预算及截止节点；截止之后应等待下一阶段公告。
items.why_it_matters_en: The procurement has an identified buyer, estimated value and deadline; subsequent status depends on the buyer's next notice.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟踪采购结果及后续设备和服务需求，避免将截止日期视为授标。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track the award decision and subsequent equipment or services demand; the deadline is not an award.

items.title: Nakheel授予Dubai Islands西岸线海工和沙滩改造合同
items.title_en: Nakheel awards Dubai Islands western-shoreline marine and beach works
items.summary: Nakheel于10月8日宣布，将Dubai Islands Island B的海工及海滩工程合同授予Mar Marine & Building Contracting L.L.C.；项目拟新增320米海滩并改造约3公里西岸线，预计2027年第四季度完成。
items.summary_en: On 8 October, Nakheel announced it had awarded Mar Marine & Building Contracting L.L.C. a marine and beach works contract for Island B at Dubai Islands. The project will add 320 metres of beach frontage and upgrade roughly 3km of western shoreline, with completion targeted for Q4 2027.
items.why_it_matters: 属正式授标工程，涉及防波堤、海岸防护及海滩建设等专业工程。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is an awarded works package covering breakwaters, coastline protection and beach development.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟踪施工进度及承包商后续公开采购安排。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track construction progress and publicly announced procurement by the contractor.

items.title: 阿曼杜库姆经济特区授出1380万里亚尔内部道路合同
items.title_en: Oman's Duqm Special Economic Zone awards RO13.8 million internal roads contract
items.summary: 阿曼经济特区相关机构公布授出约1380万阿曼里亚尔的杜库姆内部道路网络工程合同，旨在改善特区内部交通、基础设施服务和工业发展条件。报道日期为10月20日。
items.summary_en: Omani authorities announced the award of an approximately RO13.8 million contract for an internal road network within the Duqm Special Economic Zone to improve transport and infrastructure supporting industrial and urban development. The report was published on 20 October.
items.why_it_matters: 项目属已授标工程，金额为道路项目合同额。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is an awarded civil works contract, with the stated sum referring to the roads package.
items.gci_opportunity: 留意工程进展及后续经证实的供应链采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor implementation and any verified follow-on supply-chain procurement.

items.title: 英国出口融资署为几内亚La Côtière Conakry输电项目提供1.29亿英镑支持
items.title_en: UK Export Finance supports Guinea's La Côtière Conakry power transmission project with £129 million
items.summary: 英国出口融资署10月20日公布，为几内亚La Côtière Conakry输电工程提供约1.29亿英镑融资支持，该工程属于沿海地区电网升级计划，相关合同由Elecnor获得。
items.summary_en: On 20 October, UK Export Finance announced approximately GBP129 million in support for Guinea's La Côtière Conakry transmission project, part of a broader coastal grid upgrade programme. Elecnor secured the associated contract.
items.why_it_matters: 该融资支持现有输电项目推进，不意味着出现未授标的新EPC合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: The financing supports a transmission project already under contract and does not constitute a newly open EPC tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注已签约主体的项目执行与设备供应链公告。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor the contracted company's delivery and confirmed equipment-supply notices.

items.title: 日立能源宣布在巴西投资7700万美元建设变压器部件工厂
items.title_en: Hitachi Energy announces US$77 million Brazilian transformer-component plant investment
items.summary: 日立能源10月22日宣布在巴西投资约7700万美元，建设用于变压器关键部件的制造设施，扩大当地电力设备生产能力。该投资使公司在巴西计划的累计投资提高至约3.5亿美元。
items.summary_en: On 22 October, Hitachi Energy announced an approximately US$77 million investment in a Brazilian manufacturing facility for key power-transformer components. The announcement brings its planned investments in Brazil to around US$350 million.
items.why_it_matters: 该消息为新工厂投资计划，尚不可等同于施工承包商已获授合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: The announcement concerns a manufacturing investment; it does not establish an awarded construction contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注后续工厂建设、设备采购与投产进度。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track plant construction, manufacturing-equipment procurement and commissioning updates.

items.title: 西班牙马德里公布中小企业咨询辅导服务采购计划
items.title_en: Madrid announces procurement plan for advisory and mentoring services for SMEs
items.summary: 马德里自治区经济、财政与就业部门于9月17日公布面向创业者、个体经营者及中小企业的咨询与辅导服务采购计划，分2个标段，估算金额208.49万欧元。公开采购记录显示该项目处于预公告阶段，尚不能认定已开放投标。
items.summary_en: On 17 September, the Community of Madrid's economy, finance and employment department announced a proposed two-lot procurement for advisory, consultancy and mentoring services for entrepreneurs, self-employed workers and SMEs, with an estimated value of EUR2.0849 million. The published notice is a prior announcement, not evidence of an open tender.
items.why_it_matters: 该项目说明计划采购方向及预算，不是已授标项目，也未确认正式投标期。
items.why_it_matters_en: The notice indicates anticipated procurement and budget, not an award or a verified open bidding period.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注正式招标公告及实际投标条件。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor the formal tender and actual submission requirements.

items.title: 英国出口融资署支持贝宁8200万英镑政府行政综合体建设
items.title_en: UK Export Finance backs £82 million government administrative complex in Benin
items.summary: 英国出口融资署10月20日公布，提供8200万英镑融资支持贝宁新政府行政综合体建设项目，建设合同已授予ACC UK Group Ltd，项目涉及设计、工程、安全系统及其他专业设施。
items.summary_en: On 20 October, UK Export Finance announced GBP82 million in financing support for a new government administrative complex in Benin. The contract was awarded to ACC UK Group Ltd, with project scope involving design, engineering, security systems and specialist building services.
items.why_it_matters: 属于融资支持且合同已授予的公共工程，非公开待投标主合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a financing-backed public construction project whose main contract has already been awarded, not an open main-contract tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注合同执行阶段公布的专业工程及设备供应信息。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor announced specialist-work and equipment-supply packages during delivery.
